courseName: [OHS 101 ALL SECTIONS] Occupational Health and Safety-I
title: Week 2
name: Chapter 2 (October 5 - October 11, 2026)
content:
We will cover "Health and Safety at Laboratories - II" topic in second week.

The level of detail of this chapter are below.

- Learn safe and healthy acts, rules, and safe working practices,

- Learn how to take counter measures against risks and project consequences of unsafe and unhealthy working conditions,

- Learn how to communicate in emergency situations.
